name: 63070 · Pevely, MO
findings: ZIP 63070 (Pevely) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63070 (Pevely) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63070 (Pevely) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
